ABOUT THE COMPANY

Engineering for the Jewellery Industry

Procast Tech was established in 1999 with a vision to support the jewellery manufacturing industry with dependable and practical machinery solutions.

Founded by P. Rajendran, the company focuses on jewellery casting, gold and silver melting, wax injection, vacuum and centrifugal casting, and jewellery polishing machinery.

With a focus on precision, durability and customer-oriented service, Procast Tech continues to develop machinery solutions for modern jewellery production.
